name: What is the process for widening a doorway in my home?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for widening a doorway in my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process typically begins with an on-site assessment to determine if the wall is load-bearing and identify any electrical, plumbing, or HVAC lines. For non-load-bearing walls, the existing door frame and surrounding drywall are removed, the opening is expanded, and new framing is installed. For load-bearing walls, temporary supports are erected, and a new header is installed to redistribute the load. Finally, new drywall, trim, and paint are applied to match the existing interior.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves an assessment, removal of existing frame, expansion of the opening with new framing, and finishing with drywall and paint. Load-bearing walls require structural support.
